# Social Media & Content Creator Tools (social-tools)
- Telegram Deep-Link & Pre-Filled Message Generator: Create instant t.me links, custom bot launch parameters, pre-filled chat text, and scan-ready QR codes.
- [Instagram Unfollowers & Data Export Delta Tracker](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/social-tools/instagram-unfollower-checker): Private, client-side detection of non-reciprocal accounts and recent unfollower deltas from Meta export ZIPs.

# Text Tools (text-tools)
- [Compare Two Lists & Set Difference Finder](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/text-tools/compare-two-lists): Find differences, intersections, unions, and complements between two text lists.
